title: Who Gets Which Message? Auditing Demographic Bias in LLM-Generated Targeted Text

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring differences in lexical content (using odds ratios and WEAT scores on gender-stereotypical lexicons), language style (formality and emotion classifiers), and persuasive framing (Persuasion Bias Index calculating agency, modal certainty, and imperative usage) across male- and female-targeted generated messages.

Measuring differences in lexical content (using odds ratios and WEAT scores on age-stereotypical lexicons), language style (formality and emotion analysis), and persuasive framing (Persuasion Bias Index) across messages generated for four different age groups: young adult, early working, late working, and senior.
